data.name: OH! RPG!
data.detailed_description:
Presentation



Deep enough for the veteran roleplayer... Humorous enough for the casual gamer!

OH! RPG! is a quirky, innovative and colorful adventure by RosePortal Games (of Epic Quest and Whisper of a Rose fame) and released on Steam by RPG veteran Aldorlea Games.

The game consists of 8 chapters, each with a different atmosphere, gameplay and protagonist, all contributing to an exciting and fresh experience.
Mixing elements of parody and great use of interaction with an enthralling storyline, this game is a quality blend of pure RPG goodness - but with an unique twist!


Plot



Heroes always win. But what happens to those who don't?
The world is coming to an end and the heroes return home after their ludicrous failure, to be with loved ones for whatever's left.

Except this time you're not going to play them. Who wants to play failures anyway?
In OH! RPG!, traditional roles are reversed. You play the NPCs and help the heroes along the way.

  • See the story from another perspective and embark with a new protagonist in each of the 8 chapters
  • Travel from front to back, from awe-inspiring castles to your remote peasant village, from enemies super strong and big, to end up proudly defeating... pathetic slimes?
  • Enjoy a collection of unique protagonists such as an upbeat Jester, a quickwitted Goblin or even the Hero's own family, as you interact with them in an innovative way
  • Visit 8 chapters, all with a different style and optional content to discover!

Features



  • Unique battles using the special skill "Hero Calls": Harold, Therese, Marsha and Lucius are never in battle, but you can call them and wait until they arrive, and they will perform one powerful move - this is different for each battle depending on where they are in the story
  • End-level ratings based on performance
  • Stage selection to replay levels and improve your ratings in each
  • Global User Rank based on overall end-level results - unlock goodies with higher scores!
  • Collect material to upgrade the power/efficiency of your weapons, armor and potions
  • Unlock skills of RPG Maker History like Call Ralph!, Mapping Tool or Summon Don Miguel
  • FREE license original resources for everyone who purchases the game to use - includes 4 side-view monsters, some side-view battlers, tileset, charsets, and even the airship above!*
  • Steam Achievements & Steam Trading Cards!
  • Mouse, keyboard and gamepad/controller fully supported, with non-invasive full screen or windowed mode and higher resolution graphics

*Find your free resource pack here:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\OH! RPG!\Resources


Meet our Heroes!



Harold
A simple farm boy with big dreams of seeing the world. Always level headed and one to help another in need. Tries to be friends with everyone he comes in contact with. Expert cow milker!

Therese
A tough princess who trained herself as a knight so she could one day leave the castle walls. She's never afraid to use her title to get her way. Often impatient and comes off as cold when talking to others. Expert at judging people.

Marsha
A mysterious girl with an even more mysterious past. Her lighthearted and mischievous behavior has landed her into hot water countless times. Always looking for a way to be important to the people around her. Expert at playing tricks on others.

Lucius
Often described as stiff as a book's spine yet somewhat sarcastic. Even though he is a priest, he questions everything within the teachings. Always willing to help those in need but is never looking for thanks. Expert at disapproving books.


TIP: When playing on Windows XP and experiencing issues, please launch the game manually at:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\OH! RPG!\Game.exe

reviews.review:
OH! RPG!, developed by RosePortal Games and published by Aldorlea Games, stands out by taking a familiar fantasy premise and turning it on its head. Instead of placing legendary heroes at the center of the adventure, the story explores what happens after those heroes fail in their mission to save the world. The spotlight shifts to the ordinary individuals who are usually relegated to the background of traditional role-playing games, including villagers, merchants, goblins, and other unlikely protagonists. This creative narrative direction gives the game an immediate sense of originality, blending comedy with heartfelt storytelling while encouraging players to see a fantasy world from perspectives that are rarely explored. The result is an adventure that feels fresh despite embracing many classic RPG traditions.

Rather than following a single protagonist throughout the campaign, the game is divided into eight interconnected chapters, each featuring a different playable character with their own circumstances and motivations. Every chapter contributes another piece to the larger narrative, gradually revealing how the actions of the fallen heroes have affected the kingdom. This episodic structure keeps the experience engaging by constantly introducing new environments, personalities, and gameplay situations. The writing is filled with humorous dialogue, clever references to classic role-playing games, and surprisingly emotional moments that give even the most ordinary characters meaningful development. By the conclusion, these seemingly separate stories come together into a satisfying tale that rewards players who appreciate strong world-building and character-driven storytelling.

Gameplay remains rooted in traditional turn-based RPG mechanics while introducing several ideas that distinguish it from more conventional entries in the genre. Battles rely on careful use of character abilities, equipment, and strategy, but one of the most entertaining mechanics is the Hero Calls system. Instead of permanently controlling the world's legendary champions, players can summon them during combat to unleash powerful special attacks that reflect their place within the unfolding story. This feature cleverly ties gameplay to the narrative while adding an extra tactical layer to encounters. Beyond combat, players can gather materials, upgrade equipment, unlock additional abilities, and revisit previous chapters to improve rankings and earn higher completion scores. These optional progression systems encourage replayability without making them mandatory for those who simply wish to experience the story.

Visually, OH! RPG! embraces the nostalgic appeal of classic pixel-art role-playing games while making excellent use of expressive character portraits, colorful environments, and charming sprite animations. Although it clearly draws inspiration from older RPG Maker titles, the presentation remains lively thanks to the variety of locations and the unique atmosphere found in each chapter. The soundtrack complements the adventure well, shifting naturally between playful melodies during comedic scenes and more dramatic compositions when the stakes become serious. Controller support, Steam achievements, trading cards, and additional content for aspiring RPG creators further round out a feature set that offers more value than its modest appearance initially suggests.

What ultimately makes OH! RPG! memorable is its confidence in telling an unconventional story without abandoning the mechanics that fans of classic role-playing games enjoy. Its humor is consistently entertaining, but it never relies solely on jokes, allowing genuine emotional moments and thoughtful character arcs to emerge throughout the adventure. While some players may find the visuals somewhat dated or wish for deeper customization and more complex combat systems, these limitations are outweighed by the game's imaginative premise, engaging chapter-based structure, and likable cast. It succeeds by proving that the lives of ordinary people can be just as compelling as those of legendary heroes, delivering an experience filled with charm, creativity, and personality from beginning to end.

Overall, OH! RPG! is an inventive and enjoyable indie role-playing game that offers a refreshing twist on fantasy storytelling while remaining faithful to the genre's classic roots. Its memorable cast, creative mechanics, and lighthearted yet meaningful narrative make it an easy recommendation for players who appreciate story-focused RPGs with a sense of humor and a willingness to challenge convention.

Rating: 7/10
